features.name: Dynamics 365 Business Central cloud platform
features.description: A comprehensive all-in-one business application suite for small and medium businesses providing tools to manage finance, service, sales and operations with a holistic view of company data available in over 130 countries.

features.name: AI capabilities for repetitive tasks
features.description: AI features that help people with repetitive tasks on a daily basis and improve job satisfaction by automating routine work.

features.name: Microsoft 365 Suite integration
features.description: Integration with Microsoft 365 including business intelligence with the Power Platform to visualize data in new ways.

features.name: Dynamics 365 Copilot
features.description: Copilot functionality that unleashes productivity and enables people to do things they never thought they could do before.

features.name: Inventory management optimization
features.description: Inventory management capabilities that help businesses maintain optimal inventory levels and enable focus on product delivery and market responsiveness.

features.name: Automated workflows
features.description: Automated workflow capabilities to optimize productivity and streamline business processes.

features.name: Real-time insights and cash flow visibility
features.description: Real-time insights into cash flow and visibility into key performance metrics available at any time and location for informed decision making.

features.name: Azure-based infrastructure
features.description: Built on Azure cloud infrastructure with reliability, security and compliance features.
